AttachedBlocks.description: Blocks attached to piston (excluding head) with slime and honey blocks.

BreakBlocks.description: Blocks prevents piston from moving, such as obsidian.

LastProgress.description: Latest successfully changed state progress, which determine piston movement.

NewState.description: Required by redstone state, if nothing blocking way, piston moves.

Progress.description: Percent between `0` and `1` (with in-game step `0.5`), where `1` means activated.

State.description: Currently state, `0` means pulled, `1` moving and `2` pushed.

Sticky.description: Whether piston crafted with slime and can transfer blocks back.
